{{nihongo|'''Kuniichigi Shrine (Morito, Sakado)'''|国渭地祇神社(坂戸市森戸)}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Musashi Province]].
